terra.problem: The line says Ishmael grew up in Paran, but Genesis 21:20–21 says he grew up in the wilderness and later lived in Paran; it does not specify where he grew up.
“The other men” suggests all the other spies opposed Caleb. Joshua also supported entering the land (Numbers 14:6–9). Say “the other men who spoke up” or “most of the spies” instead.
